subtitle: Architectural Design Practice II

授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal: This course aims to expand upon the knowledge gained in Architectural Design Studio I and engage in the design of larger and more complex architectural projects with extensive programs. It enhances processes from investigation to proposing architectural spaces, covering zoning, flow planning, spatial configuration, and landscape design. The goal is to offer comprehensive proposals, including structural and environmental planning. Additionally, it aims to develop the ability to refine proposals and improve drawing representation techniques.

              This course aims to expand upon the knowledge gained in Architectural Design Studio I and engage in the design of larger and more complex architectural projects with extensive programs. It enhances processes from investigation to proposing architectural spaces, covering zoning, flow planning, spatial configuration, and landscape design. The goal is to offer comprehensive proposals, including structural and environmental planning. Additionally, it aims to develop the ability to refine proposals and improve drawing representation techniques.
